Under the general direction of neurodiagnostic leadership, the Senior Neurodiagnostic Technologist provides advanced neurodiagnostic services and direct patient care across diverse age groups and complex clinical conditions. The position performs the full range of routine, ambulatory, and continuous long-term EEG monitoring, including care of patients in the Epilepsy Monitoring Unit, and applies advanced technical expertise in pattern recognition and live continuous monitoring of scalp and stereotactic electroencephalograms.
15% - Other Support Duties

The Senior Neurodiagnostic Technologist also performs specialized neurodiagnostic procedures, including electrocorticography, intracarotid sodium amobarbital procedures (ISAP/Wada), and single-photon emission computed tomography (SPECT) procedures. Working with a high degree of independent clinical judgment, the technologist evaluates complex clinical situations, establishes priorities, and collaborates with interdisciplinary teams to support high-quality, patient-centered care.

As an experienced member of the neurodiagnostic team, the Senior Neurodiagnostic Technologist serves as a clinical resource and subject matter expert, contributes to patient and staff education, and provides guidance to neurodiagnostic technologists, assistants, and students. The position demonstrates leadership and professional accountability while practicing in accordance with UC Davis Health policies, ABRET and ACNS guidelines, and applicable federal, state, and local requirements.
